race.description: First Mates Lounge @ Men Matter Hcp
race.comment: WONDEREACH (10) is the main danger after sticking on gamely behind a good winner last start and now meets the winner with a good pull at the weights. Should be hitting his straps now and can turn the tables. POWER OF THE BRAVE (4) drops back from Saturday company after closing off nicely into fourth at Doomben. His improvement was encouraging and sets up well dropping back to a winning trip off a month in-between, though the wide draw will test. HEARTONI (5) was wide throughout when beaten just under 2L as favourite in the same race as WONDEREACH. Had won well at Rockhampton before that, so he remains a genuine hope if he reproduces that sharper form. CHAKRA BOY (1) is better than we've seen recently and a return to his best can see him feature in the finish.
